sourcebase.basis: published receipt and supplied parent verification; local detached HEAD/tree checked; child made no new remote query
sourcebase.new_source_freeze: explicit actual dependency files only; no mutable old-root scan or old source_manifest call

session_policy.run_role: default native child assigned RUN-only scope
session_policy.technical_failure: PAUSE, fresh technical recovery review, automatic own --recover

environment.determinism: preserve source settings and source seeds; no added global deterministic-algorithms switch

data_policy.preprocessing: train only, existing exact split/cache hashes

training.none_zero: None skips private Adam; tensor zero remains active with decay/moments/step

loader_rng.restore: deep copies; restore source loader/Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG last

algorithm.absent_class: pi0 if cell nonempty; missing class means/variance/entry coefficient null
algorithm.lambda_zero: engineering only exact source CLEAN delegate

unselected_alternatives.necessary_control: variance/norm-matched isotropic noise for direction claim; reused CLEAN/AXIS-EVEN/IID2 contextual controls
unselected_alternatives.reason_not_selected: weak KR 2/5-positive signal; mean-risk confound more directly evidenced

unselected_alternatives.necessary_control: norm-matched unprojected ranking residual plus W baseline; reused N/C
unselected_alternatives.reason_not_selected: no demonstrated conflict mechanism; more complex vector/Adam activity contracts, prior norm/feedback counterevidence

controls.requirements: recorded initialization/order/config/optimizer/state/validation/selection provenance plus fresh finite source-equivalence fixtures
controls.missing_field_policy: preserve unavailable/null; never fabricate or demand retroactive fields

selection.rule: independent online/EMA earliest strict maximum over epochs1..50
selection.logloss: same AUC-selected state, negative delta favorable

statistics.repeated_validation_adaptation: exploratory; populations/seeds/history shared across cycles, not independent replications

gates.Test: explicit USER_STOPPED AND final freeze AND preexisting eligible full-five-seed selected-live-RAM verification gate

interpretation_limits: W-S combines heterogeneous class/cell/task completion weighting
N-W includes rank-gradient magnitude and downstream dynamics; not direction-only
missing S+R means ranking-by-weighting interaction unestimated
common-state real-Adam diagnostics are local, not full-trajectory mediation
fixed epochs and selected states answer different questions
size is not difficulty; no assumed curriculum/momentum efficacy
only fixed1 M3oE natural-source protocol tested

diagnostics.batch: first full batch of each diagnostic epoch
diagnostics.autograd_gradients: three objectives other than the live arm; live scalar backward supplies fourth
diagnostics.derived_gradient: g_S=m*g_C is an FP-tolerant check only; counterfactual S uses actual scalar-S autograd
diagnostics.clone_policy: sequential one clone at a time; exact source optimizer with deep copied current private states; no live mutation
diagnostics.groups: global and existing top-level named-parameter prefixes
diagnostics.probe_order: shared forward -> three autograd probes -> one live scalar backward -> four sequential virtual source-Adam steps at unchanged prestate -> one live Adam/EMA update

runtime.GPU_predicate: CURRENT memory fraction < .85 AND CURRENT power/power_limit < .85 independently per card
runtime.physical_fit: current used bytes + incoming measured full-process residency <= current CUDA-usable total bytes (100%)
runtime.first_cold_calibration: engineering staged real allocations on eligible card, measure context/full branch and protect pending startup; no formal admission before profile exists
runtime.next_admission: after first FULL step plus lazy Adam ACK, profile update and fresh measurements
runtime.formal_queue: KR first then ML, seed ascending, W then S; first physically fitting job for each independent card
runtime.profiles: own PID incl CUDA context; full/tail/lazy Adam/diagnostic/eval/cpu-copy/serialization/get/restore; grow with observed smoke/live maxima
runtime.recovery: safe PAUSE, fresh technical review, automatic new runner --recover from last whole-epoch RAM ACK with original RNG/loader; retain uncommitted/replay costs
runtime.user_stop: no admissions; finish in-flight atomic parameter/EMA operation, preserve RAM, no fake epoch ACK, final summary/freeze

storage.new_owner_start: original parent foreground imported frozen TV serve(str(new_attempt)) after code PASS
storage.restore_optimizer: deep-copy all saved state before load; no alias; RNG/loader last
storage.commit: whole epochs only, CPU immutable checkpoint -> owner commit -> get/hash/ACK reconciliation -> committed numeric receipt
storage.reply_loss: reconcile own RAM owner and journal before retry
storage.selected_retention: both online/EMA for every new run through parent direct get/hash/epoch/validation acceptance before runner closes; candidate failure does not release

required_gates_before_formal_run: fresh coder report and finite basic checks
distinct code reviewer PASS or PASS WITH FIXES with all blockers fixed
parent new foreground RAM owner after code PASS
frozen explicit source/control/data/run manifests and actual RUN model identity

smoke_contract.sequence: full+tail prefix; populated source CLEAN/lambda0 full-step fork pair; full+tail suffix; NEW-owner prefix roundtrip and full+tail restored suffix
smoke_contract.engineering_keys: new isolated ordinals, scientific_epochs0; never fake epoch50
smoke_contract.proof: exact same-path model/Adam/EMA/RNG/loader/selection hashes plus recorded operation counters and physical profiles

deliverables.reason: self-hash excluded; parent may hash complete six-file bundle externally

research_child_actions.data_or_Test_write_read: no data/Test mutation; no Test access; only numeric metadata/evidence reads

pending_downstream_measurements: actual engineering and code review verdicts
next_action: Original parent accepts research completeness, dispatches fresh designer fork_context=false; proceed through IMPLEMENT/distinct REVIEW/engineering/signoff/fresh DEFAULT Luna-high RUN/parent ANALYZE/actual main publication/fresh Astra; no user confirmation needed.
